schemaVersion.description: System finance transaction schema version. Always finance-transaction-v1.

sourceFileName.description: Complete original file name supplied by Make. It must be returned without modification.

totalPages.description: Number of pages actually present in the uploaded file, not the total printed in the statement footer.

records.description: Bank transaction rows in actual page order and top-to-bottom order within each page.

sequenceNo.description: Integer value from the bank table column 番号. It may repeat or restart and must not be renumbered. Return null when unreadable.

fileType.description: Formal document title printed on the page, such as 入出金明細照会.

type.description: income when the deposit column contains the amount, expense when the withdrawal column contains the amount, or null when unresolved.

date.description: Transaction date from 勘定日 in YYYY-MM-DD format, or null when unreadable.

counterparty.description: Original description text only when it clearly represents the counterparty name; otherwise null.

counterpartyRaw.description: Cleaned original text from the bank table column 摘要.

contentSummary.description: Cleaned original text from 摘要. It must equal counterpartyRaw and must not be translated or expanded.

transactionCategory.description: Original Japanese text from the bank table column 取引区分.

financialInstitutionName.description: Financial institution name extracted from the 金融機関名・支店名 cell.

bankBranchName.description: Branch name extracted from the 金融機関名・支店名 cell.

propertyName.description: Property name only when explicitly provided in a separate source field. Do not infer it from the bank description.

roomNumber.description: Room or unit number only when explicitly provided in a separate source field. Do not infer it from the bank description.

contractorName.description: Contractor or tenant name only when explicitly provided in a separate source field. Do not infer it from the bank description.

contractNumber.description: Contract number only when explicitly printed in a separate source field; otherwise null.

paymentMonth.description: Explicitly printed payment month in YYYY-MM format. Do not infer it from the transaction date.

feeItemName.description: System fee item name only when explicitly stated and directly matchable; normally null for bank statements.

fileAmount.description: Amount from the applicable withdrawal or deposit column, without commas, spaces, or currency symbols.

transferFeeAmount.description: Additional transfer fee is not split from a bank statement transaction row. Always 0.

statisticalAmount.description: Amount written to system statistics. It must equal fileAmount.

evidenceDateType.description: Date evidence type. Always 勘定日.

sourcePageStart.description: One-based actual uploaded-file page containing the transaction row.

sourcePageEnd.description: Same value as sourcePageStart. Do not use the statement's printed page label.

processingStatus.description: Every visible bank transaction row is included. Always INCLUDED.

confirmationStatus.description: CONFIRMED only when all critical fields are clear; otherwise PENDING.

note.description: Concise English explanation of OCR uncertainty, cropping, amount conflicts, or an uncertain institution/branch split. Empty string when there is no issue.

details.description: Bank statement rows do not create finance fee details. Always return an empty array.
